source_name: Shopify developer changelog: inventoryActivate now preserves available quantity
finding: As of Admin API 2026-04, inventoryActivate without available or onHand no longer resets retained quantities to zero; previously active/inactive InventoryLevel quantity history is preserved.
old_approach: Treat activation/connect without an explicit quantity as implicitly zeroing inventory.
new_rule: SHOPIFY_INVENTORY_ACTIVATE_PRESERVE_GATE: on API 2026-04+, never infer zero stock from inventoryActivate/connect alone. Read the resulting inventory quantity before using stock as a product-validation signal; explicit quantity changes remain separate operations.
test_metric: For 2026-04+ integrations, activation without available/onHand must preserve prior retained quantity; product scoring must use read-back quantity, not activation event semantics.
failure_fallback: If API version or post-activation quantity cannot be read back, mark inventory evidence INVENTORY_QUANTITY_UNVERIFIED and do not treat activation as proof of zero or positive sellable stock.
provenance: Official Shopify developer changelog dated 2026-04-17, checked 2026-10-05.
